purpose: Read-only metadata projection of the 902 CUDA F.dropout (fused_dropout) events of the original deterministic RF2 run, used to check the CUDA-compatible dropout counter model on the real product stream. No mask array, npz payload or neural output is copied; the projection is a diagnostic oracle that product code never imports.

source.scope: independent random-mask metadata, neural outputs never supplied
source.projection: all 902 functional_dropout event records with their recorded offset pair; the 2288 cpu bernoulli (custom CPU head) events are summarised only because that stream is untouched by this work

cpu_custom_head_stream.note: the rfantibody Dropout CPU Bernoulli head (drop_row/drop_col) is a separate CPU stream that this work does not touch
